title: Sound envelope editing: custom in/out points and volume keyframes in SoundPanel Edit... dialog
description:
## Problem

The SoundPanel "Edit..." button (visible when a frame has a sound attached) shows the tooltip "Edit envelope (not yet implemented)" and does nothing. This is the standard Flash 8 envelope editor that lets authors set:
- **In point / Out point**: trim the start/end of the sound clip
- **Volume envelope**: up to 8 custom (samplePos, leftLevel, rightLevel) keyframe points per channel

Without this, users cannot fade sounds in/out, pan between channels, or trim long audio clips — core Flash 8 authoring features.

## Current model state

- `SoundLinkage` in `packages/core/src/model/types.ts` has `effect?: SoundEffect` (preset: fadeIn/fadeOut/left/right/etc.) but NO fields for custom envelope points, inPoint, or outPoint.
- `packages/swf/src/sounds.ts` already defines `SoundEnvelopePoint` (`{ pos32: number; leftLevel: number; rightLevel: number }`) and `SoundInfoOptions.envelope` for encoding, but these can only be populated via preset expansion (`effectToEnvelope`), not user-defined keyframes.

## What to implement

### 1. Extend `SoundLinkage` model

```ts
export interface SoundEnvelopePoint {
  readonly pos32: number;      // sample position / 32  (same unit as SWF SoundInfo)
  readonly leftLevel: number;  // 0-32768
  readonly rightLevel: number; // 0-32768
}

export interface SoundLinkage {
  ...
  readonly inPoint?: number;                        // start sample (in raw samples, 0 = full)
  readonly outPoint?: number;                       // end sample (undefined = full)
  readonly customEnvelope?: readonly SoundEnvelopePoint[];  // overrides effect preset
}
```

Add these fields to the round-trip serialization (`serialize.ts` / `deserialize.ts`) and unit-test them in `soundlinkage.test.ts`.

### 2. Wire into SWF encoding

In `packages/swf/src/compile.ts` `encodeStartSound` call: pass `inPoint`, `outPoint`, and `customEnvelope` (or preset expansion if no custom envelope). `encodeSoundInfo` in `sounds.ts` already accepts all three — just needs the model data plumbed through.

### 3. SoundEnvelopeEditor dialog

Create `packages/authoring-ui/src/SoundEnvelopeDialog.tsx`:
- 400×200 canvas showing a stereo waveform visualisation (or placeholder bars if no dataUri / not decoded)
- Draggable left/right trim handles for inPoint/outPoint on the timeline axis
- Up to 8 draggable envelope keyframe handles (diamond shapes) per channel
- Default: 2 keyframes (pos=0, pos=end) at level 32768 (full) — matches Flash 8 default
- "OK" / "Cancel" buttons

Wire the "Edit..." button in `SoundPanel.tsx` to open this dialog with the current `SoundLinkage` data and call an `onEnvelopeChange` callback on confirm.

### 4. Shell wiring

In `Shell.tsx` (or the frame-sound edit path), handle the envelope change callback: update the `SoundLinkage` in the frame via `pushDoc`.

## Acceptance criteria

- Unit tests: `SoundLinkage` with `customEnvelope` and `inPoint`/`outPoint` round-trips through `saveFla`/`loadFla`.
- SWF encoding test: a SoundLinkage with 2 custom envelope points produces a StartSound SoundInfo with the correct envelope bytes (use `encodeSoundInfo` unit tests as pattern).
- UI: clicking "Edit..." on a frame with sound opens the dialog; confirm propagates envelope to the doc.

## Files

- `packages/core/src/model/types.ts` — extend SoundLinkage (+ SoundEnvelopePoint)
- `packages/core/src/fla/serialize.ts` / `deserialize.ts` — persist new fields
- `packages/swf/src/compile.ts` — pass envelope/inPoint/outPoint to encodeStartSound
- `packages/authoring-ui/src/SoundEnvelopeDialog.tsx` — new dialog component
- `packages/authoring-ui/src/SoundPanel.tsx` — wire Edit... button
- `packages/authoring-ui/src/Shell.tsx` — handle envelope change callback
